description: A Java class 'LogView' extending TextView that implements LogNode interface, used for displaying log data in an Android application. It formats log messages and appends them to the view, supporting chaining with other LogNodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for outputting log data received through the LogNode interface, with methods for formatting and displaying log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, including priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable, to the LogView and chained LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
